summary.text: Roger Wilder is a Republican member of the Louisiana House of Representatives, representing District 71 (Livingston Parish), and was elected in 2023, according to the official House member page.

paragraphs.text: The member page lists Roger Wilder's occupation as Business Owner.
It lists education as Archbishop Shaw High School, 1994.

The page lists committee assignments including Insurance, Labor and Industrial Relations, Ways and Means, the House Executive Committee and the Joint Legislative Committee on Capital Outlay, and caucus affiliations including the Capital Region Legislative Delegation, the Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation and the Louisiana Rural Caucus.
